content: Access to Persisted Remote Data Items Description: Remote Persistency shall support central persistent storage of data items of Adaptive Applications. Additional Information: Remote Persistency links service interfaces for access to remote data items to a storage based on the Key-Value Storage of Persistency. Rationale: Applications need to access and share data items that are updated independently and stored persistently. These data items are typically central settings of the vehicle, but could also be data items that require an independent and central update.
